newsitem.title: LATVIA: C.BANK SEES FURTHER FALL OF T-BILL RATES.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK SEES FURTHER FALL OF T-BILL RATES.

text.p: Central bank governor Einar Repshe said on Wednesday that he saw further falls in government Treasury bill rates.
"Rates continue to fall, slowly but irresistibly," Repshe told a news conference.
"That especially refers to interbank and government short-term T-bill rates, with the average rate well below four percent," he said.
The average rate for one-month paper is nearing three percent, two-month paper is on average below four percent, Repshe said.
"The rate of six-month paper is on average slightly above four percent and obviously is going to keep reducing," Repshe said.
